name: Albert Heijn
notes: Albert Heijn is the largest Dutch supermarket chain. Passkeys are a passwordless sign-in method, not a second factor: the customer service FAQ 'Wat als inloggen met een Passkey niet lukt?' offers the password as the fallback when a passkey login fails. The account settings payload lists Passkeys under 'Inloggegevens' separately from the MFA options (SMS code, email code, AH app), and the site's GraphQL schema exposes CiamPasskeyRegisterStart/Finish and CiamPasskeyUpdate mutations distinct from CiamUpdateMfaSetting. Verified from the live page; login.ah.nl itself returns 403 to non-browser clients so the sign-in screen was not inspected directly. Submitted via community issue #27.
